story.iWant: record cash/bank payments and allocate them to AP bills or expenses
story.soThat: outflows are controlled and correctly posted to the general ledger

tasks.task: Validate Existing AP Payment Domain Alignment (AC: #1-#5, #9-#10)
Frontend – Payment Form and List UX (AC: #1-#4, #6, #9)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Payment form captures: date, auto-number (CP-YYYY-seq), payee (supplier/other), reference, amount (>0), selected cash/bank account (active), payment method (cash/transfer), and attachment (required above threshold). Required fields validated client- and server-side.
When payee is a supplier, UI shows unpaid/part-paid bills with remaining balances, supports FIFO default allocation with manual override, displays running remaining per bill and overall total.
Overpayment is blocked; error lists bills where allocated amount exceeds remaining; user must adjust or remove allocations to proceed.
Standalone payments to expense accounts (6xx/8xx) are permitted per policy; ad-hoc payee (not in supplier master) requires reason and is audit-tagged.

Posting creates vouchers with: Cr Cash/Bank (1111/1121 via account.glAccountCode) and Dr AP (331) for allocated supplier payments or Dr Expense (6xx/8xx) for standalone payments; rounding and precision match GL engine rules.
Before posting, system checks sufficient cash/bank balance; overdraft attempt is logged and either blocked or warned per configuration; block shows current balance and shortfall.

CSV/Excel import supports header-based templates, atomic processing (all-or-nothing), row-level error mapping, and attachments mapped by filename. Errors include row number, field, and user-friendly message.
Payments above threshold or marked sensitive route to approval; approver ≠ maker enforced server-side; notifications sent to approvers; all state transitions are audit-logged.
Typical create + post of a simple payment completes within ≤ 10 seconds, measured from submit to server response; quick keyboard entry supported; latency logged for observability.

All create/edit/post/approve/reject/reverse/import/download actions for payments generate audit entries capturing payload diffs and event hashes; blocked attempts are flagged separately for investigation.

file.reason: Core payment service interface defining create, update, allocateFIFO, postPayment, cancelPayment methods. Extend for balance guard and standalone expense support.
Current payment posting logic with maker-checker pattern, voucher creation, and bill status updates. Add balance guard check and GL account code lookup.
Existing POST /api/v1/ap-payments/{id}/post endpoint. Reference for RBAC annotations and response patterns.
Bank account entity with glAccountCode field. Used for GL posting credit entries.
PENDING_APPROVAL status pattern to mirror for PaymentStatus if not already present.
Reference for GL account code lookup via bankAccount.glAccountCode, threshold-based maker-checker, and telemetry patterns from Story 6.2.
Existing integration tests for payment posting and maker-checker workflow validation.
Reference for payment form structure including customer picker, bank account selection, allocation grid, and attachment handling.
Multi-file attachment dropzone with drag-drop, progress tracking, and 10 files/20MB limit. Reuse/adapt for PaymentAttachmentDropzone.
Allocation grid showing invoices with remaining balances. Adapt for bill allocation in payment form.
Repository methods for GL account code queries and transaction references.

constraints.constraint: Reuse existing APPaymentService and /api/v1/ap-payments endpoints. Do not create new cash-specific tables; use existing ap_payments and transaction_allocations tables.
All posting and reversal actions must go through VoucherService from Epic 3, ensuring double-entry invariant (NFR11) and period close constraints (FR05, NFR12).
All entities must implement CompanyScopedEntity for row-level security via company_id filtering.
RBAC checks enforced server-side. Never rely purely on frontend hiding of controls.
Maker-checker pattern: approver ≠ creator for PENDING_APPROVAL payments. Roles: CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT, CFO, ADMIN can approve.
Maintain standard { data, meta, error } response wrapper. Use consistent error codes for validation failures, RBAC denials, balance guard violations, and period-close violations.
Payment create + post ≤ 10 seconds end-to-end. Add latency logging for observability.
Follow existing AP payment testing patterns from Epic 4. Include positive/negative test cases for allocation logic, balance guard, period validation, and reversal workflows.
